companyFieldUpdates.description: KAPS is a dual-pipeline system in Alberta that transports natural gas liquids and condensate from the Karr area to Keyera's processing and fractionation network. The system serves upstream producers and downstream infrastructure users through contracted pipeline transportation. Public materials describe roughly 560 kilometres of pipeline and planned throughput capacity of up to 350,000 barrels per day on the NGL line. Keyera has owned 100% of KAPS since acquiring Stonepeak's remaining 50% interest on June 17, 2026; the system remains active.
